name: lp2p-shim
description: Experimental polyfill for the WICG Local Peer-to-Peer API (LP2PReceiver, LP2PRequest, LP2PConnection, LP2PDataChannel) over pluggable in-browser transports. Not secure.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p tsconfig.idl.json
scripts.check-dist: node scripts/build.mjs && git diff --exit-code -- dist && test -z "$(git status --porcelain -- dist)"
